newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * President Emil Constantinescu leaves for Dublin this afternoon to reaffirm Romania's political will to integrate in the European Union.
* Members of the new cabinet led by Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea take over portfolios from their predecessors.
* New Defence Minister Victor Babiuc said he would focus on continuing reforms to bring Romanian army in line with Western standards and make efforts to join NATO.
* Calin Popescu Tariceanu, Minister of Trade and Industry, said assuring winter stocks and deregulating foreign trade activity would be his main priorities.
* Agriculture Minister Dinu Gavrilescu said he wanted to make a clear and strong reform of the sector but also protect farmers from hardships.

* The team of International Monetary Fund experts, which is evaluating the state of Romania's economy, will have its first official meeting with Ciorbea this afternoon. The meeting is followed by a news conference.
